summary: 65-year-old Tulsa, Oklahoma visitor suffered a medical emergency at Lake Haiyaha, collapsed and fell on rocks, then rolled into the lake; family and other visitors pulled him out; a trail crew reached him within minutes and rangers provided advanced medical care; litter-carried to the Bear Lake parking area and flown by AirLife of Denver to Swedish Medical Center
location: Lake Haiyaha, Bear Lake area, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP rangers/trail crew; AirLife of Denver
notes: Incident date pinned to Thu 2011-09-08: report filed Mon Sep 12; weekday-verified.
